decisions.reason: A quantified customer-savings case and strong fit with the modular core range mean uncertainty has largely resolved in its favor, so keeping it offers more value than abandonment.
The mobile slow-speed shredder remains close to the established machinery base, but the newer shredder line creates some portfolio-overlap risk even though the option is still worth keeping open.
As a flagship multi-model modular line aligned with the firm’s strategic direction toward cleaner modular solutions, it is highly unlikely to be withdrawn in the next year.
This new shredder line sits near the core business and is still in the early learning phase, so real-options logic favors keeping it while demand and application breadth become clearer.

The spiral shaft screen line extends the processing-system portfolio and deserves more time for market learning, though its newer and somewhat more exploratory position leaves a moderate withdrawal risk.
